description: This is an Android activity class for a wallpaper picker application, allowing users to select wallpapers from a predefined set of images displayed in a gallery.

classes.name: Wallpaper
classes.description: Main activity class providing a wallpaper selection UI for Android home screen.

classes.name: Wallpaper.ImageAdapter
classes.description: Inner class that provides image views for the gallery of wallpaper thumbnails.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and configures the gallery.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resets the wallpaper set flag when activity resumes.

methods.name: onItemSelected
methods.description: Changes background when a gallery item is selected.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Sets the wallpaper when an image is clicked.

methods.name: selectWallpaper
methods.description: Sets the selected image as wallpaper, synchronized to prevent double application.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch events to set wallpaper based on current selection.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of images in the gallery.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the position index for an item.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the ID for an item, here just the position.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates and configures an ImageView for a thumbnail in the gallery.
